name: Mansion Tycoon 🌴🏠
desc:
👍 Like and favorite the game to show us you want more mansions! 👍

Build a mansion, penthouse, or yacht, drive cool cars, race your cars at the race track, roleplay with other players, and so much more in this epic mansion tycoon!
